title: carduus kerneri subsp. scardicus
intro: Carduus kerneri subsp. scardicus, commonly known as Balkan thistle, is a subspecies of thistle native to the Balkan Peninsula. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carduus kerneri subsp. scardicus include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect the liver. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
